question: CF 9 is related to IL 21 in a certain way. In the same way, MP 29 is related to SV 41. To which of the following is KN 25 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'CF 9' is related to 'IL 21'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb7492724b12592cdd8c889104ec702b116c08a4ba1572d4ed49be6aeb7b98f6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/591fdd9b6668870ee4c1ec7db9084a9330fa4477b47ce4d8d778a403c40617c4.png] 

'MP 29' is related to 'SV 41'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dced45646a3cf0205cba85041d49a04270f99a7166a7d3f29e26f60c4a384f4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dda0dd616ce78e123cd8b3e458a1e31b2b3b9f1e2ac93452b9c3ecc9e31c269.png] 

Similarly, for 'KN 25'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b189be4d5786564ddf6bfd94994cbf20a94ca9ed9c5babc82c719d9e4115aadd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ef4a24ad78c92d9378a0996a43610541abf19831df6433665bc9862fc5d9b0.png] 

So, 'KN 25' is related to '**QT 37**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
